scripts.install:all: cd mfe-shell && npm install && cd ../mfe-vue && npm install && cd ../mfe-react && npm install && cd ../mfe-angular && npm install
scripts.build:remotes: cd mfe-vue && npm run build && cd ../mfe-react && npm run build && cd ../mfe-angular && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && npm run build:remotes && concurrently -n vue,react,angular,shell -c green,blue,red,cyan "npm run dev:vue" "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:angular" "npm run wait-for-remotes && npm run dev:shell"
